home.name: Crisp Signal Notebook
main: A compact direct-publish smoke test: the site snaps into a surreal field notebook with sharp rules, specimen strips, colored tabs, and signal arrows pinned to the page.
The machinery stays visible and working. The dial still switches versions, the Versions page still logs the run, the feedback form still posts to /api/site-signal, and Version 1 remains untouched.
home.quote: Keep the loop intact; let the margins misbehave.

about.title: Notebook Skin
paragraphs: This version turns the whole site into a crisp surreal notebook: less dream fog, more exact ink, bright tabs, ruled paper, and small impossible diagrams arranged like evidence.

The redesign is data-driven through the selected contributor version. The baseline article content remains the locked Version 1 object, while this version supplies its own copy, theme, assets, and image treatment.

timeline.title: Direct Publish Path
paragraphs: The lineage keeps one version per contributor. This direct-publish handle gets one slot, one generated skin, and one latest signal entry that can move from generating to merged without duplication.
Read the layout as a compact lab note: title block, ruled surfaces, specimen images, run link, and a console that keeps reporting the latest automatic chaos state.

notes.title: Loop Notes
paragraphs: The request is treated as a design brief only: no secrets, no infrastructure edits, no disabled checks. The result lives in version data, CSS flavor rules, and static assets.
The feedback loop remains part of the page instead of being painted over. The top-right dial, Versions ledger, local visitor cookie, and POST contract still belong to the shared renderer.
